“Listen,” he quoth impressively. “I speak better Spanish than either of you two Morgans. Also, I know, I am confident, the Spanish woman character better. To show you my heart’s in the right place, I’ll go in to her now and see if I can talk her out of this matrimonial proposition.”

One of the spearmen barred Torres’ way, but, after going within, returned and motioned him to enter. The Queen, reclined on the divan, nodded him to her graciously.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0019", "tag": "p", "text": "“You do not eat?” she queried solicitously; and added, after he had reaffirmed his loss of appetite, “Then will you drink?”", "sha256": "e2a3d63c50f83f6365b18bf4667fbdc8ddc7871f45751318b6c402dbb2a4377e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1781]", "source_html": "

“You do not eat?” she queried solicitously; and added, 192after he had reaffirmed his loss of appetite, “Then will you drink?”

Between the excitement he had gone through for the past several days, and the new adventure he was resolved upon, he knew not how, to achieve, he felt the important need of a drink. The Queen clapped her hands, and issued commands to the waiting woman who responded.", "sha256": "6382541c37316763bf19c0bbed586f3b957ea6d932f0f1467ca96d5a11a1e6fa", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1782]", "source_html": "

Torres’ eyes sparkled. Between the excitement he had gone through for the past several days, and the new adventure he was resolved upon, he knew not how, to achieve, he felt the important need of a drink. The Queen clapped her hands, and issued commands to the waiting woman who responded.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0021", "tag": "p", "text": "“It is very ancient, centuries old, as you will recognize, Da Vasco, who brought it here yourself four centuries ago,” she said, as a man carried in and broached a small wooden keg.", "sha256": "28e38a78a780f316c7382ad1631397892ee814cf086729dabb8ff236bbc5e284", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1783]", "source_html": "

“It is very ancient, centuries old, as you will recognize, Da Vasco, who brought it here yourself four centuries ago,” she said, as a man carried in and broached a small wooden keg.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0022", "tag": "p", "text": "About the age of the keg there could be no doubt, and Torres, knowing that it had crossed the Western Ocean twelve generations before, felt his throat tickle with desire to taste its contents. The drink poured by the waiting woman was a big one, yet was Torres startled by the mildness of it. But quickly the magic of four-centuries-old spirits began to course through his veins and set the maggots crawling in his brain.", "sha256": "1d116f585615619c4349144a3f94dde313e5e16aa5e499b7a9f12caff314ad0e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1784]", "source_html": "

About the age of the keg there could be no doubt, and Torres, knowing that it had crossed the Western Ocean twelve generations before, felt his throat tickle with desire to taste its contents. The drink poured by the waiting woman was a big one, yet was Torres startled by the mildness of it. But quickly the magic of four-centuries-old spirits began to course through his veins and set the maggots crawling in his brain.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0023", "tag": "p", "text": "The Queen bade him sit on the edge of the divan at her feet, where she could observe him, and asked:", "sha256": "1b69e949f61704ebdb48bca2938ca71f4887847ab9e8493531656f65705a4305", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1785]", "source_html": "

The Queen bade him sit on the edge of the divan at her feet, where she could observe him, and asked:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0024", "tag": "p", "text": "“You came unsummoned. What is it you have to tell me or ask of me?”", "sha256": "85e4c6003dc28278a5936198bb0dcedb887d1646d4eed3eb74ee9f1750a4ee86", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1786]", "source_html": "

“You came unsummoned. What is it you have to tell me or ask of me?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0025", "tag": "p", "text": "“I am the one selected,” he replied, twisting his moustache and striving to look the enticingness of a male man on love adventure bent.", "sha256": "5ed0e4c635fe4c46d59936e77872b6352783b0085cfa05e560749d688becbb53", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1787]", "source_html": "

“I am the one selected,” he replied, twisting his moustache and striving to look the enticingness of a male man on love adventure bent.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0026", "tag": "p", "text": "“Strange,” she said. “I saw not your face in the Mirror of the World. There is ... some mistake, eh?”", "sha256": "9807d0fb3a789bea6e28740dec240a422c1cd70ef961d6646603c56f2b48e529", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1788]", "source_html": "

“Strange,” she said. “I saw not your face in the Mirror of the World. There is ... some mistake, eh?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0027", "tag": "p", "text": "“A mistake,” he acknowledged readily, reading certain knowledge in her eyes. “It was the drink. “A mistake,” he acknowledged readily, reading certain knowledge in her eyes. “It was the drink. There is magic in it that made me speak the message of my heart to you, I want you so.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0028", "tag": "p", "text": "Again, with laughing eyes, she summoned the waiting woman and had his pottery mug replenished.", "sha256": "819d3334542a21d2b9c6eb4fbf3a7b623cbfce935ef168edf8a2cad3522ae524", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1790]", "source_html": "

Again, with laughing eyes, she summoned the waiting woman and had his pottery mug replenished.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0029", "tag": "p", "text": "“A second mistake, perhaps will now result, eh?” she teased, when he had downed the drink.", "sha256": "e0d47556e1bf09dcc378424a020f5e47e5f8298c87fb945ac2f3af07d376d45a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1791]", "source_html": "

“A second mistake, perhaps will now result, eh?” she teased, when he had downed the drink.

“No, O Queen,” he replied. “Now all is clarity. My true heart I can master. Francis Morgan, the one who kissed your hand, is the man selected to be your husband.”
